proposition: The entry for Taqdīm al-ʿAql ʿalā l-Nafs gives no date and lists no copy in MS Majlis 10196; one manuscript notes it was presented to a Dawlat-i Sayyidiyya-yi Imāmiyya-yi Rażaviyya, whom the entry does not identify, and which is a note on that copy, not shown to be the work's own dedication.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
mediation.note: a note on one late copy
